_comment: Payment model of the ops suite: mapping of the product contract (ops-framework/docs/ADDING_A_CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_MODEL.md) to this landscape. Generated by tools/payment_model.py into src/paym (active sections) and config/payment_model/pending (sections waiting for a VERIFY item). Expressions are CDS fragments over the tables / views named in from and joins. Only confirmed or already-delivered fields are active (docs/USAA_Known_Tables.md); everything else is null with its VERIFY note, or a pending section.

notes: Base: ZI_CD_PayLifeRun - the newest non-proposal DPAYH row of every payment document, run date LAUFD in the
last 45 days (key range of the DPAYH primary index; Performance_Review.md section 11). Flow from TFK042Z-XEINZ of
the company code country, method class from posting area ZPMC (ZI_CD_PayMethodCls), source / outcome / finding
/ late from the payment worklist (ZI_CD_PayWorkState; a clean payment has none - source unknown bucket).
joins: left outer join tfk042z            as Pm  on  Pm.land1        = Cc.Country

CompanyCurrency.verify: Released view I_CompanyCode (C1, VERIFY.md V110) - Currency, Country (country of TFK042Z); TFK042Z stays a table read (no released view)

Flow.expr: cast( case when Pm.xeinz = 'X' then 'C' when Pm.zlsch is null then ' ' else 'D' end as abap.char( 1 ) )

TransactionType.verify: V83: transaction of the request (field of ZCD_PAYM_REQ_LOG confirmed by the user 2026-11-11, name VERIFY-SE11) - reached through the request (pending section); blank until then

RequestStatus.verify: V84: business request lifecycle status (PENDING / SCHEDULED / SRCPOSTED / source reject) - no confirmed table / field (control_seed.md section 2a P2)

MethodClass.expr: cast( case when Pm.xeinz = 'X' then McC.MethodClass else McD.MethodClass end as abap.char( 3 ) )

HouseBankAccount.verify: V87: DPAYH-HKTID (account ID, never the bank account number) not yet confirmed - blank until SE11

notes: Payment -> requests: open items cleared by the payment document (DFKKOP-AUGBL = payment document, confirmed
join) with their FIN number (DFKKOP-ZZ_FIN_TRANS_NUM, confirmed); one row per payment and FIN. Request ->
payments reads by ZZ_FIN_TRANS_NUM (index of pre-check 0.8); payment -> requests by AUGBL (index V88).

CompanyCode.verify: VERIFY-DDIC DFKKOP-BUKRS (standard name, as config/hck_seed.md section 4)

request.reason: V82: FIN-number, received date / time, company code, currency and amount fields of ZCD_PAYM_REQ_LOG and the transaction field are VERIFY-SE11 (docs/USAA_Known_Tables.md); the SUCCESS-row rule is applied (never the highest COUNTER)
notes: The accepted attempt of a request = its row with ZZ_STATUS SUCCESS (confirmed rule: never the highest COUNTER,
a failed attempt can be written after the success).

RequestReference.expr: cast( Log.‹FIN number field› as abap.char( 40 ) )

FeederReference.expr: Log.‹feeder business reference field (claim / policy / invoice)›
FeederReference.verify: V89 VERIFY-SE11; masked by default (feeder row REF_VISIBLE blank)

request_attempt.reason: V82: FIN-number, company code and received time fields of ZCD_PAYM_REQ_LOG are VERIFY-SE11

RequestReference.expr: cast( Log.‹FIN number field› as abap.char( 40 ) )

IsAccepted.expr: cast( case when Log.zz_status = 'SUCCESS' then 'X' else ' ' end as abap_boolean )

request_event.reason: V90: the hops need a consumer union view (request log received time, PRISM status API / FMON event of the request's file, payment run, ZCD_SPE_EXCP_LOG status sent back) - the link request -> file and every SPE field are VERIFY-SE11
request_event.from: ‹ZI_CD_PaymHops - union of the hops, built after SE11› as Hop

notes: Items cleared by the payment document (DFKKOP-AUGBL = payment document, confirmed join) with the reconciliation
key (FIKEY) of the CLEARING document's header (DFKKKO-OPBEL = AUGBL): the clearing posts the offset of every
cleared item on the item's account under the clearing document's FIKEY, so per account and currency the payment's
FI-CA amount within the FIKEY total (DFKKSUMC) is the sum of its cleared items (VERIFY V101). The bank clearing
account side of the payment is reached through the bank line (FEBEP -> BSEG-XREF2 = AUGBL) and the batch key
level, not as an item. Transaction texts: text tables not confirmed (V103) - blank until SE11. Reads only by
payment document (index AUGBL, V88) or by FIKEY (DFKKKO index FIKEY, V102).

SubledgerItem.expr: cast( concat( concat( Op.opupw, Op.opupk ), Op.opupz ) as abap.char( 20 ) )
SubledgerItem.verify: V101 VERIFY-SE11 DFKKOP-OPUPW / OPUPK / OPUPZ (item key, as the trace item read)

BatchKey.verify: V101 FIKEY of the clearing document carries the clearing's account postings (DFKKKO-FIKEY confirmed field)

GlAccount.verify: V101 VERIFY-SE11 DFKKOP-HKONT (reconciliation account of the item)

Amount.verify: V101 VERIFY-SE11 DFKKOP-BETRW (transaction currency, signed as DFKKSUMC-BETRW?)

MainTransactionText.verify: V103 main transaction text table (TFKHVOT candidate) not confirmed - blank

SubTransactionText.verify: V103 sub-transaction text table (TFKTVOT candidate) not confirmed - blank

BusinessPartner.verify: masked to the last four by the product view (trace rule)

notes: Summary records of the payment engine G/L transfer: DFKKSUMC grouped per FIKEY, company code, account and
currency (confirmed path DFKKSUMC-FIKEY = DFKKKO-FIKEY = BKPF-AWKEY; G/L reference key = FIKEY, reference type
TRACE_GL_AWTYP FKKSU = model gl_reference_type). Posting date = the latest BUDAT of the key's records. The key
status (open / closed) is a field of the reconciliation key header (DFKKSUM, candidate) - V102, blank until SE11;
transferred / not transferred is derived from the G/L document (product view), the gap finding stays A_GL_TRANSFER.

GlReferenceKey.verify: BKPF-AWKEY = FIKEY (confirmed path; V104 AWKEY form of a 12-character FIKEY)

BatchStatus.verify: V102 reconciliation key status (open / closed) - DFKKSUM field VERIFY-SE11; blank until confirmed

Amount.verify: VERIFY-DDIC DFKKSUMC-BETRW signed (as A_RECON_3WAY; V101 same sign as ACDOCA-WSL)

notes: Clearing / transit accounts of the three-way reconciliation configuration (ZCD_HCK_RCSET, active sets): one row per
company code, G/L account and currency (several sets of one account - kinds - collapse to one row).
Stored results of A_RECON_3WAY (ZCD_HCK_METRIC RC_* of the latest measurement per group-day and the check's
findings of that run, helper views ZI_CD_LedgRcLast / ZI_CD_LedgRcPiv / ZI_CD_LedgRcDay) - reused, never
recomputed: the stored G/L leg is the FKKSU part of ACDOCA on the clearing account in ledger EBS_GL_LEDGER.
Bank lines of the payment engine accounts (ZI_CD_HckRcBankLine: account of FEBEP-XBLNR as EBS) of the reconciled
sets (ZCD_EBS_ACCT house bank account -> ZCD_HCK_RCSET of the same company code, house bank, account ID and
currency). Clearing document = FEBEP-CHECT (methods E G H I J K L: CHECT = AUGBL, confirmed; for cheques CHECT is
the cheque number - V105, not resolved here). ClearingChanged = the referenced payment document was reversed
(DFKKKO-STBEL; a clearing reset needs the history, V100). The G/L clearing line (BSEG-XREF2 = AUGBL) is not joined:
BSEG has no index on XREF2 (HCK VERIFY item 14) - blank until the index or the clearing-account restriction is
confirmed (V106); the payment ledger and the batch key reach the journal instead.
joins: inner join zcd_hck_rcset as RcSet on  RcSet.bukrs  = Acct.bukrs

Amount.verify: absolute FEBEP-KWBTR; the sign is DebitCredit (EPVOZ, EBS_FEB_CREDIT_IND / _DEBIT_IND)

ClearingDocument.verify: CHECT = AUGBL for methods E G H I J K L (confirmed); cheques: V105

ClearingChanged.expr: cast( case when Clr.stbel is not null and Clr.stbel <> ' ' then 'X' else ' ' end as abap_boolean )
ClearingChanged.verify: reversal by DFKKKO-STBEL; clearing reset needs the history (V100)

GlFiscalYear.verify: V106 G/L clearing line by BSEG-XREF2 = AUGBL needs an index (BUKRS / XREF2) - blank until confirmed

notes: Reversals (DFKKKO-STBEL) and stopped cheques (DPAYH status STOPPED) of the payments of the payment model window
(ZI_CD_DocEvtU). Clearing reset / re-clearing / reissue link need the clearing-reset history (TRACE_SRC_HISTORY,
DFKKRAPT candidate, V100) - not mapped until confirmed; returns (DFKKRP) are not change events.
